cookbook_title: The complete guide to Sony's Alpha 6000 digital camera
description:
xvi, 598 p. : 23 cm

A comprehensive easy to understand guide which explains each feature in plain English and provides hundreds of visual examples as well

"The friendly manual with professional insights."

Includes index

The Alpha 6000 in a nutshell -- My personal camera settings -- Quick guide for the impatient user -- Using legacy glass -- WI-FI, NFC, and apps -- The recording (camera icon) menu -- The custom (gear icon) menu -- The WI-FI menu -- The application menu -- The playback menu -- The setup (suitcase icon) menu -- Movie mode and its menu -- Wireless flash and advanced flash topics -- DRO and HDR -- Digital imaging topics -- Additional resources -- A condensed guide to the basics -- A "cookbook" for special situations
